thread:
nina: Opening a short ops thread: we need a safer unpin flow for cross-region runtime changes. Proposal below.

hugo: quick summary?

nina: TL;DR: staggered regional soft-unpin + a combined "regression score" to avoid noisy rollbacks. Rules: 
- Stages: EU -> NA -> APAC, wait windows 20m, 30m, 30m respectively.
- Regression score = 0.5*p95-lift% + 0.3*5xx-abs% + 0.2*OOM-count-normalized. Trigger auto-revert if score >= 25 for 2 consecutive windows.
- Token gating: require >=800 tokens/s across the region being promoted.
- Cost guardrail: if fallback route increases cost >1.5x for >10m, pause and require ops signoff.

deploybot: [info] planned runtime soft-unpin: runtime v3.4.2 -> model-group llama3x-multi at 2024-09-12T11:03:10Z (initiated by @nina). Stages scheduled according to policy.

ops: add note: APAC cold caches often show transient p95 spikes during handoff; recommend KV prefill + slow-jitter rollout to smooth.

qa-bot: preflight QA check: 30-seed synthetic gen -> 1 flagged (<=5% threshold) -> pass. Will run generation at each promotion step.

hugo: also add publishable audit note: auto-actions must append a short line to the release log: "auto-action: <revert|soft-unpin> reason: <primary-signal>" so product can track customer-facing notes.

nina: agreed. I'll attach runbook snippets to the scheduled deploy:
```
/deploy soft-unpin runtime v3.4.2 --regions=eu,na,apac --stages=10,25,100 --observe=20m,30m,30m --regression-threshold=25
/deploy cancel 1765432190
```

hugo: decision: proceed with staged soft-unpin and the regression score. Owners: @nina (runbook + release log), @ops (cost), @qa-bot (QA checks). Keep this thread for post-mortem notes.
